scope: Final Stage-2 web-resource authority plus pinned official website-source and linked-code repositories were inspected statically. Three explicitly paper-support experiment workflows are mapped; general demos remain resource-level evidence and license scopes remain separated.

unresolved_findings.finding: The CC-BY-4.0 license applies to the website source and does not establish a license for the linked code repository.
The linked code has no root LICENSE while setup.py simultaneously records LICENSE='(TBD)' and an MIT classifier; no repository-level SPDX is inferred.
The bundled DFlex component has its own NVIDIA source-code license and must not be generalized to the whole gradSim repository.
The environment is only partially pinned: Python/PyTorch guidance and one Sphinx pin are present, but most Python dependencies and Kaolin/USD versions are not fixed.
Paper workflows reference cached HDF5/input assets and bundled support material, but a complete immutable dataset manifest for all experiments is not established.
Paper-support workflows hard-code CUDA device usage and setup.py builds CUDA extensions, but an exact tested GPU/CUDA toolchain is not pinned.

notes: One explicit license-metadata conflict is preserved.
No scientific software, notebook, model, dataset, training, inference, evaluation, test, runtime environment or dependency installation was executed.
